text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"Sizzly-sizzle, tasty stir-fried veggies♪ 
A heaping bowl of piping-hot rice♪"

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Downing the miso soup in one big gulp~...♪ 
One big gulp...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
...Huh, what was it again? Go whaaam, and 
then...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
What should I do, I can't remember! And 
after I went through all the trouble of 
making a "Set Meal Song"~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ughhh, this is driving me crazy! Doesn't 
anybody know what happens next~?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the end, Matikane Tannhauser was left 
feeling frustrated, unable to remember the 
lyrics...
